[[File:Talus_Tralus_EotECR.png|thumb|right|250px|Talus and Tralus were a pair of double planets.]]
'''Double planets''' were pairs of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of approximately the same size and mass that orbited each other and together shared an orbit around that [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]] or stars. [[Bpfassh]] was an arid double planet with a complicated system of [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. During the [[Thrawn campaign]], Bpfassh had [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] defending the planets from their third moon.<ref name="HTTE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
